title: Yet Another Literary Prizewinner Seems to Be AI
source_used: none (The Atlantic blocked; no other reputable outlet carries the AI claim)
why_it_matters_hint: Headline only: The Atlantic says a Caine Prize-winning short story seems to be AI, the latest literary prizewinner to face such doubts.
notes: The Atlantic page returned 403 (Cloudflare block). Searches found no other reputable outlet carrying the AI claim. Literary Hub (7 Oct 2026) and other outlets report that the 2026 Caine Prize went to Simbarashe Steyn Kundizeza's 'The Blue Fighter', but none mentions AI, so the entry does not name the story or the writer as the subject of the Atlantic piece. An opinion blog (stevesailer.net) mentions the Atlantic piece but was not used.
